                               ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICA GO:


SECTION 1. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance

be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-M in the area bounded by


       West Potomac Avenue, North Waller Avenue; a line 98.70 feet south
       of and parallel to West Potomac Avenue; and the alley next west of and
       parallel to North Waller Avenue,


to those of a Cl-2 Neighborhood Conimercial District.



SECTION!. This ordinance shall be in force and effectftomand after its passage

and due publication.




Common Address of Property:         1256 North Waller Avenue

NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR PROPOSED REZONING FOR A TYPE 1 ZONING
             AMENDMENT - 1256 NORTH WALLER AVENUE/

     The current zoning of the parcel is RS-3 Residential District. The zoning
amendment is required to change the zoning of the parcel to Cl-2 Commercial District.
The zoning change is needed to allow the Church to operate a commercial kitchen on
premises. There will be no exterior changes to the existing church 2 Vz story building.


Lot Area:                         12,258.54 sq. ft.

FAR:                                1.09

Building Area:                    13,407.8 sq. ft.

Density/Dwelling Unit:                N/A

Off Street Parking Spaces:          6 spaces

Front Setback: (Existing)          11.27 ft. Fronting Waller Avenue

Rear Setback: (Existing)            1.17ft.

Sideyard (North): (Existing)        Zero ft.

Sideyard (South): (Existing)         3.24 ft.

Building Height: (Existing)           32 ft.

After rezoning, the property shall be used to operate a Commercial Kitchen
